_help: Cap Table and Dilution Simulator settings. founders: who starts with the company (percent). rounds: the starting rounds. types: the round types with their fields and a one line explanation. The maths is simplified on purpose: a SAFE counts as a post-money SAFE (amount divided by the cap), a priced round sells new shares at the pre-money valuation, a SAFT sells future tokens (amount divided by the token valuation) and does not change shares, and token warrants give shareholders a share of the token supply in line with their shares.

safe.label: SAFE
safe.line: A promise of shares later, at a price set by its cap.

priced.label: Priced round
priced.line: New shares sold now at a set valuation.

saft.label: SAFT
saft.line: A promise of tokens later. It does not sell shares.

warrant.label: Token warrants
warrant.line: Shareholders get rights to tokens, in line with their shares.

note: Simplified on purpose: no option pool, no SAFE discounts or pro rata rights. Real terms change the numbers.
